title: F-Zero 99
subtitle: Ninety-nine machines share the circuit
summary: F-Zero 99 is Nintendo Software Technology's online racing game, released for Nintendo Switch Online members on 14 September 2023.
body: F-Zero 99 is Nintendo Software Technology's online racing game, released for Nintendo Switch Online members on 14 September 2023. It uses the circuits and machines of the original Super Nintendo F-Zero to stage races with as many as ninety-nine competitors. The familiar flat tracks become crowded contests in which reaching the finish depends on surviving collisions as well as driving quickly. The Blue Falcon, Golden Fox, Wild Goose and Fire Stingray return with different strengths for finding a way through that traffic.

The energy meter measures both damage and the fuel available for boosting. Spending it can gain a position but leave the machine vulnerable before the next repair strip. A spin attack pushes other vehicles aside, while knocking out a rival can increase the survivor's energy capacity. As the race progresses, minimum placement requirements remove slower competitors. The player must balance the immediate need to escape elimination with the energy needed to stay intact through the following corners and collisions.

Super Sparks collected from the track fill a separate meter that opens access to the Skyway, a temporary elevated road above the race. It creates an opportunity to overtake the pack without driving through every obstruction below. Grand Prix events extend the contest across several races, making survival and accumulated results part of the same goal. F-Zero 99 finds a new use for the original game's compact circuits by changing the number of people trying to occupy their fastest line.
story_headings: Speed spends the same energy as survival
Find the road above the traffic
